title: ATC: Agent Trajectory Control for Role-Contract Enforcement in Black-Box Multi-Agent Systems
title_zh: ATC：面向黑盒多智能体系统角色契约执行的智能体轨迹控制

paragraphs.en: 提出ATC方法将多智能体角色权限形式化为契约并强制执行，显著降低角色漂移并提升任务性能与角色一致性。 Multi-agent LLM systems assign different responsibilities to different agents: one plans, another retrieves evidence, another verifies, another executes. This division of labor is only meaningful if each agent stays within the functions it is authorized to perform. Over many turns, however, an agent can produce a locally reasonable message that exercises authority belonging to another role: a verifier that begins planning, a retriever that asserts unsupported conclusions, an executor that changes state no one approved. We formalize this as role drift, a turn-level breach of an agent's role contract. We introduce Agent Trajectory Control (ATC), which makes each role's authority explicit as a contract and enforces it at the point where a message would enter the shared conversation. ATC scores a proposed output for out-of-role deviation, leakage into the functions of other roles, impermissible speech acts, and logical contract breaches, then computes a leakage-regularized target that constrains regeneration; the revised message is re-checked before admission. Enforcement acts on the message rather than the generator, so ATC governs agents whose internal representations are unavailable. Across homogeneous and heterogeneous teams, ATC improves task performance and role consistency while lowering role-drift energy relative to strong baselines spanning prompting, memory, workflow control, and activation editing, with the largest gains under explicit role-confusion stress tests and in larger, more diverse teams.
paragraphs.zh: 提出ATC方法将多智能体角色权限形式化为契约并强制执行，显著降低角色漂移并提升任务性能与角色一致性。多智能体LLM系统为不同的智能体分配不同的职责：一个负责规划，另一个负责检索证据，另一个负责验证，另一个负责执行。 只有当每个智能体始终在其被授权执行的职能范围内行动时，这种分工才有意义。 然而，经过多轮交互后，一个智能体可能产生一条局部合理、却行使了属于其他角色权限的消息：验证者开始规划，检索者断言未经支持的结论，执行者更改无人批准的状态。 我们将此形式化为角色漂移，即智能体在轮次层面违反其角色契约。 我们提出智能体轨迹控制（ATC），将每个角色的权限明确为一个契约，并在消息即将进入共享对话的节点上强制执行该契约。 ATC对候选输出进行评分，衡量其超出角色的偏离、向其他角色职能的泄漏、不许可的言语行为以及逻辑契约违规，然后计算一个经泄漏正则化的目标来约束再生成；修订后的消息在被采纳前会再次接受检查。 强制执行作用于消息而非生成器，因此ATC可以治理内部表征不可获取的智能体。 在同质与异质团队中，相较于涵盖提示、记忆、工作流控制和激活编辑的强基线，ATC提升了任务性能与角色一致性，同时降低了角色漂移能量，在显式角色混淆压力测试下以及在规模更大、更多样化的团队中收益最大。
